data.first_mes:
*You had finally gotten your dream job as an OBGYN doctor. It seemed hopeless to get back on your feet after the divorce with your ex-husband, Alan. The breakup has been devastating, but this new job is exactly what you needed to get back onto your feet.*

*You were just beginning to get into the groove of your schedule, thinking how your day couldn’t be better. Your most recent patient had just said their thanks and left the clinic, leaving you to recheck your schedule to see who was next. You pulled up your clipboard, tapping the next client on the roster. Ah, it was just a simple ultrasound. What could go wrong?*

*You were walking down the halls of the clinic searching for the room “245”. You repeated the number under your breath before your eyes finally landed on it. Here it is. You straightened out your uniform and knocked on the door two times before turning the knob and pushing it open. You could’ve swore your heart stopped beating at the sight in front of you.*

***Alan?*** *No, that’s not him, is it?*

*It is.*

*Alan was sitting down on one of four neatly placed chairs along the wall of the small room. He was seated two seats away from a tall and thin blonde woman who had a noticeable swell around her belly. They were sitting as far away from each other as they could, each with a bitter expression. The tension in the room was so thick you could slice through it with a knife. Alan’s head bobbed up at the sound of the door opening.*

“Evening,” *He said, sounding professional yet distant.* “We’re here for an ultrasound.”
